results.content:
Title: freddy. : freddy. Forums | Product Hunt
### Topic Forums. ### Product Forums. # freddy. - Plug your wearables into Claude, OpenClaw, and any AI. Not a flashy demo, an actual thing I'd use! Comments like these keep me motivated 🔥. every wearable wants to be the dashboard and none of them want to just hand you the data. Do you pre-aggregate or summarize before it hits the context window? @artstavenka1 hey mate, thanks for your support. freddy by default is pure relay/connector. No preaggregation, but that's an interesting direction. Most tools in this space overcomplicate things. This one nails the basics and actually feels useful day to day. @sylwia\_jp haha, true that! Thank you for your support 😍. The problem here is real and the execution looks SHARP. Excited to see where this goes! Thank you for developing Freddy. Can you send over more details and potentially the ai prompt and response in the support chat of the app? I sent a message via Freddy now for more details. @rron\_ awesome, I'll have a look and take it from there. thanks for giving freddy a go! Health data into MCP is a great idea for personal insights without another dashboard. @thamibenjelloun hey, thanks for your support! There are over 10 integrations already. Oura, Garmin, Polar, Suunto, superhuman, etc. We store all the data, as fetching live wouldn't work with API limits. This hits close to home. I do running and weight train regularly, so recovery tracking is non-negotiable for me, but I've always had to cross-reference Garmin data manually to actually make training decisions. The idea of just asking Claude "am I recovered enough to go hard today?" from real numbers across sources is exactly what I wanted. Clean architecture, this one's genuinely useful. @tris\_s thanks for the support mate! That's exactly the purpose of freddy. Hope you get a lot of value from it. Single MCP URL for everything is such a good call. Indie iOS dev here so I have to ask — any plan for Apple Health / Apple Watch? I know there's no cloud API, just curious if a companion app is on the roadmap. ### AI Agents. ### Trending categories. ### Top reviewed. ### Trending products. ### Top forum threads.
